reel.facebook: A social media schedule should fit the work your business already has to do. Start with one job, match posts to real capacity, batch repeatable tasks, assign response ownership, and review useful signals each month.
reel.instagram:
A practical weekly social media schedule for a small business:

• Monday: choose one customer problem
• Tuesday: create one clear post
• Wednesday: answer and route questions
• Thursday: reuse the idea with judgment
• Friday: review and adjust

#SmallBusiness #SocialMediaMarketing #ContentPlanning
reel.linkedin: Small businesses do not need a calendar that assumes unlimited time. A durable schedule protects service capacity, turns real customer questions into repeatable formats, assigns response owners, and records what the work taught the team.
reel.x: A durable small business social schedule starts with capacity: choose one job, batch repeatable work, assign response ownership, and review the month before adding more tasks.

photo.facebook: Build a schedule around customer work: plan, publish, respond, reuse carefully, and review the evidence. The right cadence is the one your team can staff.
